topic: Data Import - Hostel and Transport Data
summary: Outlines the requirements and process for importing hostel and transport-related data, including fee structures and detailed allocations.
steps: 1. Provide hostel fee data, noting any installment divisions (e.g., 4 parts like tuition fees, one-time security).
2. If the detailed hostel module is to be fully utilized, provide hostel names, room details, and bed allocations.
1. Provide transport fee data, including installment divisions (e.g., 4 installments) and area-wise fees (e.g., 24,000, 28,000, 32,000 for different routes).
2. If the detailed transport module is to be fully utilized, provide bus numbers, pick-up points, and student divisions by bus/route.
The ERP team will provide sample Excel formats for data import.
Fill the sample Excel with accurate and complete data.
The ERP team will import the data.
business_rules: Hostel fees and transport fees can be divided into installments.
Transport fees are typically structured area-wise (e.g., based on distance or region).
Detailed hostel (room/bed) and transport (bus/route) data can be imported if the respective modules are to be fully utilized for management beyond just fee collection.
important_notes: The ERP has a full hostel module, but detailed room/bed allocation data needs to be provided if it's to be run.
Transport data requires bus numbers, pick-up points, and student allocation for full module functionality.
Accurate data is crucial for correct fee imposition and management within these modules.
The ERP team will share sample Excel files for both hostel and transport data import.
